crossRefs.note: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:

people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Hathach
people.line: A eunuch in the court of King Ahasuerus.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:
translations.bsb: Then Esther spoke to Hathach and instructed him to tell Mordecai,
translations.kjv: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;
translations.asv: Then Esther spake unto Hathach, and gave him a message unto Mordecai saying:
